limitations: Controlled single-lane Car scenarios against real SUMO with point junctions and no internal links.
Single-JVM simulator comparisons; cold independent codec tests cover the added wire fields.
Boundary clearance is also covered by checkpointed capacity-wait and signal-history regressions.
Trip-time acceptance is one HTC global tick per road link plus one SUMO 0.1 s step for these fixtures.
Residual integer-tick boundary rounding and simplified car-following remain; no arbitrary-network calibration claim.
No finite junction conflict geometry, lane-changing, dense insertion-demand or non-Car SUMO calibration.
Mixed MICRO Bus/Subway/walking cases validate model integration, not Bus/Subway agreement with SUMO.
Harness terminates JVMs after acknowledged engine stop; process return codes do not prove clean application shutdown.
Failed first parked-car fixture attempts and intermediate fixes are excluded from accepted final runs.
Raw /tmp artifacts may disappear on reboot. Tracked generators, validators and this summary preserve reproduction.
